Set the DIP switch on the VS, or UniSystem Main Board to select the options you want. Switches | and 2 are used to select the value of the coin slot. Switches 3 and 4 are used to set the amount of time or innings per credit (the game software looks at whichever comes first—time expired or innings completed).
